en: Finals.ID joins you into the lobby with your login. The game will not show the lobby: the test shows whether you are pulled into the match.
zh: Finals.ID 会用你的登录信息把你加入房间。游戏不会显示房间：该测试用于确认你是否被拉入对局。

en: The opponents have until the end of the clock to submit. If they do not, Finals.ID sets the result from the screenshots of your team.
zh: 对手需在倒计时结束前提交。若未提交，Finals.ID 将根据你方队伍的截图判定结果。

en: Sends your ping during Ranked and Cashout matches, so finals.id can keep a full ping graph of each match. Only you can see it.
zh: 在排位和提现对局中发送你的延迟，让 Finals.ID 记录每场对局的完整延迟曲线。仅你可见。

en: The screenshots of the two teams show different results. An admin reviews this match. Your rating does not change until then.
zh: 两队截图显示的结果不一致。管理员将审核本场对局，审核完成前排位分不会变化。

en: Open Steam when you want to play, and the app links up on its own as soon as Steam is running. It never opens Steam for you.
zh: 想玩时请打开 Steam，Steam 一运行，应用就会自动关联。它绝不会替你启动 Steam。

en: Stop the Discord bot from giving you the ranked role. Your level role stays. Only works while you're outside the top 10,000.
zh: 阻止 Discord 机器人给你发放排位身份组。等级身份组会保留。仅在你不在前 10,000 名时有效。

en: Too many declined or missed matches are bad for the game. Players who do this often are flagged for disruptive behavior.
zh: 过多拒绝或错过对局会影响游戏环境。经常这样做的玩家会被标记为扰乱行为。

en: Your account is linked. It usually takes about 2–5 minutes for your stats to show up here. Hang tight, then hit refresh.
zh: 你的账号已关联。数据通常需要约 2–5 分钟才会显示在这里。请稍等，然后点击刷新。

en: Don't forget to ask Embark about an official API! Email their community email, open supports tickets, anything helps!
zh: 别忘了向 Embark 询问官方 API！发邮件到他们的社区邮箱、提交支持工单，任何方式都有帮助！

en: Each player must take the screenshot on their own PC. Take your own screenshot of the final scoreboard and upload it.
zh: 每位玩家都必须用自己的电脑截图。请自行截取最终计分板并上传。

en: This system is not affiliated with Embark Studios nor does it provide access to Embark's official ranked rewards.
zh: 本系统与 Embark Studios 无关联，也不提供获取 Embark 官方排位奖励的途径。

en: A void match with another site admin, to test FIDR from the map bans to the result. It never counts for rating.
zh: 与另一位站点管理员进行的作废对局，用于测试从禁用地图到结果的完整 FIDR 流程。不计入排位分。

en: Solos only play against Solos. Trios only play against Trios. A premade team never plays against solo players.
zh: 单排只匹配单排，三排只匹配三排。预组队不会与单排玩家对战。

en: After the game has been running for about 10 minutes, sample your Steam status and restore to that next time.
zh: 游戏运行约 10 分钟后，采样你的 Steam 状态，并在下次恢复为该状态。

en: Steam is open but didn't answer. Make sure it's signed in to an account that owns THE FINALS, then try again.
zh: Steam 已打开但无响应。请确认已登录拥有 THE FINALS 的账号，然后重试。

en: We found no ranked RS for you, so Finals.ID picks a starting rating near the middle of the FIDR players.
zh: 未找到你的排位 RS，因此 Finals.ID 会在 FIDR 玩家中游附近为你选择初始排位分。

en: The lobby host sends each test player an in-game invite, and the test records what each call answered.
zh: 房间房主会向每位测试玩家发送游戏内邀请，测试会记录每次调用的响应。

en: Immediately blank the token from our servers, removing our ability to keep refreshing your data.
zh: 立即从我们的服务器中清除令牌，使我们无法继续刷新你的数据。

en: Hide your rank score and tier on your profile. Only works while you're outside the top 10,000.
zh: 在个人资料中隐藏你的段位分和段位。仅在你不在前 10,000 名时有效。

en: If your team does not upload, Finals.ID sets the result from the screenshots of the opponents.
zh: 若你方队伍未上传，Finals.ID 将根据对手的截图判定结果。

en: The host leaves the first lobby once both players are in, then Finals.ID makes a second lobby.
zh: 两名玩家都进入后，房主离开第一个房间，随后 Finals.ID 创建第二个房间。

en: We mint a short-lived session token for your Steam account to link it with The Finals Tracker.
zh: 我们为你的 Steam 账号生成一个短期会话令牌，用于将其与 The Finals Tracker 关联。

en: Each match is one 3v3 Final Round, without the ability to change your loadout once you start.
zh: 每场对局为一场 3v3 决赛，开始后无法更换配装。

en: The server is still logging this session's matches. They show up here as soon as it has them.
zh: 服务器仍在记录本场次的比赛。记录完成后会立即显示在这里。

en: Both teams confirm the result. 4 screenshots set it at once, and 6 make every number exact.
zh: 双方队伍共同确认结果。4 张截图可直接确定结果，6 张则能让每个数字都准确无误。

en: Make sure it is the final scoreboard from this match. If it is not, upload the correct one.
zh: 请确认这是本场对局的最终计分板。如果不是，请上传正确的截图。

en: Hide your name on the ranked leaderboard. Only works while you're outside the top 10,000.
zh: 在排位排行榜上隐藏你的名字。仅在你不在前 10,000 名时有效。

en: Open Steam, then refresh again. The automatic renewal also waits until Steam is running.
zh: 请打开 Steam，然后再次刷新。自动续期也会等到 Steam 运行后才进行。

en: The names do not match the players in this match. Upload the scoreboard from this match.
zh: 截图中的名字与本场对局的玩家不符。请上传本场对局的计分板。

en: Take the screenshot at full size. Do not use a blurred image or a photo of your screen.
zh: 请截取完整尺寸的截图。不要使用模糊的图片或屏幕照片。

en: This is your in-game party. To add or remove a player, change the party in THE FINALS.
zh: 这是你的游戏内小队。要添加或移除玩家，请在 THE FINALS 中调整小队。

en: Your screenshot is missing. Upload it before the clock ends to make the numbers exact.
zh: 缺少你的截图。请在倒计时结束前上传，以确保数字准确。

en: THE FINALS is running but the tracker isn't linked — this session won't be recorded.
zh: THE FINALS 正在运行，但追踪器尚未关联——本场次不会被记录。

en: The match as players get it: map bans, the lobby code, the game and the scoreboards.
zh: 玩家看到的对局内容：禁用地图、房间代码、比赛和计分板。

en: What Finals.ID recorded for this test. It updates with every read of the session.
zh: Finals.ID 为本次测试记录的内容。每次读取该场次时都会更新。

en: When launched on startup, start hidden in the tray instead of opening the window.
zh: 开机启动时，在托盘中隐藏启动，而不是打开窗口。

en: Keep running in the tray when you close the window, so your session stays alive.
zh: 关闭窗口后继续在托盘中运行，以保持你的会话在线。

en: Hide yourself on Steam while this app signs in, then restore your usual status.
zh: 本应用登录时在 Steam 上隐藏你的状态，然后恢复你平常的状态。

en: Make sure the cash of both teams is visible, then upload the screenshot again.
zh: 请确保双方队伍的现金都可见，然后重新上传截图。

en: You also get an awesome Supporter role out of it, if you like discord stuff :P
zh: 如果你喜欢 Discord 那套的话，还能顺便获得一个超棒的 Supporter 身份组 :P

en: The invite was taken. That does not prove that the player saw it or joined.
zh: 邀请已被领取。但这不能证明该玩家看到了邀请或已加入。

en: Show a small always-on-top widget with your name, session, level and rank.
zh: 显示一个小型置顶小组件，包含你的名字、场次、等级和段位。

en: Show both teams, all six names and the whole table. Do not crop the image.
zh: 请展示双方队伍、全部六个名字和整张表格。不要裁剪图片。

en: Stats refresh live. The session refreshes automatically before it expires.
zh: 数据实时刷新。会话会在到期前自动刷新。

en: Here is what our systems have detected since the last time you logged in!
zh: 以下是我们系统自你上次登录以来检测到的内容！

en: No FIDR matches this season yet. Your matches show here after they close.
zh: 本赛季暂无 FIDR 对局。你的对局结束后会显示在这里。

en: Show the live map above General. Cards added to your layout stay visible.
zh: 在“常规”上方显示实时地图。添加到布局中的卡片会保持可见。

en: The join time of the first lobby ends early, as if nobody joined in time.
zh: 第一个房间的加入时间提前结束，就像没人及时加入一样。

en: A party in the queue cannot invite. Cancel the queue to invite a player.
zh: 排队中的小队无法邀请。请取消排队后再邀请玩家。

en: Use an image of 8 MB or less. A JPG or WebP file is smaller than a PNG.
zh: 请使用 8 MB 或更小的图片。JPG 或 WebP 文件比 PNG 更小。

en: Both admins start in the map bans. The other admin presses Join test.
zh: 两位管理员都从禁用地图环节开始。另一位管理员点击“加入测试”。

en: Check the name and the 4 digits. The player must have a FIDR account.
zh: 请核对名字和 4 位数字。该玩家必须拥有 FIDR 账号。

en: The server has no match in this session yet. Refresh to check again.
zh: 服务器尚未记录本场次的对局。请刷新后再次检查。

en: The app updates itself automatically. You can also check right now.
zh: 应用会自动更新。你也可以立即检查。

en: Shows the Admin test button in FIDR. Only admins see this setting.
zh: 在 FIDR 中显示管理员测试按钮。仅管理员可见此设置。

en: A reply that cannot be used, or an image that cannot be prepared.
zh: 收到无法使用的回复，或图片无法准备。

en: The join answered with the lobby, and the lobby lists the player.
zh: 加入请求返回了房间，且房间中列出了该玩家。

en: We cannot open this file. Take a new screenshot or save it again.
zh: 无法打开此文件。请重新截图或重新保存。

en: Only the party leader can invite, and only while a spot is open.
zh: 仅小队队长可以邀请，且仅在有空位时。

en: Start Finals.id Companion App when you sign in to your computer.
zh: 登录电脑时启动 Finals.id Companion App。

en: Your session has expired. Sign in again to see the map schedule.
zh: 你的会话已过期。请重新登录以查看地图日程。

en: The check could not place the panels or the rows of this board.
zh: 校验未能定位该计分板的面板或行。

en: The field check is switched off, or TypeSafe refused the key.
zh: 字段校验已关闭，或 TypeSafe 拒绝了密钥。

en: The problem is on our side. Upload the same screenshot again.
zh: 问题出在我们这边。请重新上传同一张截图。

en: Upload a screenshot of the final scoreboard from this match.
zh: 请上传本场对局最终计分板的截图。

en: A player with a block cannot be in a party or in the queue.
zh: 被屏蔽的玩家不能加入小队或队列。

en: Refresh your stats every 5 minutes instead of every minute.
zh: 每 5 分钟刷新一次数据，而不是每分钟。

en: The join answered with the lobby, without the player in it.
zh: 加入请求返回了房间，但玩家不在其中。

en: Accept to play. You see the opponents after the map bans.
zh: 接受即可开始。禁用地图后你会看到对手。

en: Friends show as online while their Finals.ID app is open.
zh: 好友打开 Finals.ID 应用时会显示为在线。

en: Friends won't see you playing THE FINALS during a login.
zh: 登录期间，好友不会看到你在玩 THE FINALS。

en: Finals.ID is not available. Try again in a few seconds.
zh: Finals.ID 当前不可用。请几秒后重试。

en: Your party stays together. Press Ready to queue again.
zh: 你的小队会保持组队。点击“准备”再次排队。

en: Hide parts of your public profile from other players.
zh: 对其他玩家隐藏你公开资料的部分内容。

en: You must upload a screenshot of the final scoreboard.
zh: 你必须上传最终计分板的截图。

en: ? means the screenshots did not agree on this value.
zh: ？表示各截图在该数值上不一致。

en: Pop up your session summary when you close the game.
zh: 关闭游戏时弹出你的场次总结。

en: Your team of three against a team of three opponents
zh: 你的三人队伍对战三名对手

en: What's working, what isn't, what you'd like to see…
zh: 哪些功能好用、哪些不好用、你希望看到什么……

en: Finals.ID reads the result from the screenshots.
zh: Finals.ID 会从截图中读取结果。

en: Hide any cards you don't want to see in the app.
zh: 隐藏你在应用中不想看到的卡片。

en: Hide your linked Discord handle on your profile.
zh: 在个人资料中隐藏你已关联的 Discord 用户名。

en: Invite them after their Ranked or Cashout match.
zh: 等他们结束排位或提现对局后再邀请。

en: Wait for the answer, or cancel the invite first.
zh: 请等待回复，或先取消邀请。

en: An admin reviewed this match and set no result.
zh: 管理员已审核本场对局，但未设定结果。

en: Choose, drop or paste the scoreboard screenshot
zh: 选择、拖入或粘贴计分板截图

en: Keep me Invisible when the refresh starts Steam
zh: 刷新启动 Steam 时保持隐身

en: See what changed in this and previous versions.
zh: 查看本版本及以往版本的变更内容。

en: Every member must be ready in the same region.
zh: 每位成员都必须在同一地区准备就绪。

en: Submitted, pending review. Thanks for helping!
zh: 已提交，等待审核。感谢你的帮助！

en: No matches yet. Your first result shows here.
zh: 还没有对局。你的首个结果会显示在这里。

en: These fields differ, and the result does not:
zh: 以下字段不一致，但结果一致：

en: Boot Steam for the 12-hour automatic refresh
zh: 为 12 小时自动刷新启动 Steam

en: Steam status to restore when minting is done
zh: 生成完成后要恢复的 Steam 状态

en: The player has no stored login to join with.
zh: 该玩家没有可用于加入的已保存登录信息。

en: Embark refused the call, or no answer came.
zh: Embark 拒绝了调用，或没有收到响应。

en: Finals.ID uses the screenshots that it has.
zh: Finals.ID 会使用现有的截图。

en: Hide your name on the playtime leaderboard.
zh: 在游戏时长排行榜上隐藏你的名字。

en: Experimental, may be removed in the future
zh: 实验性功能，未来可能会移除

en: Hide your name on the casual leaderboards.
zh: 在休闲排行榜上隐藏你的名字。

en: Hide your name on the weapon leaderboards.
zh: 在武器排行榜上隐藏你的名字。

en: The older matches did not load. Try again.
zh: 较早的对局未能加载。请重试。

en: This upload did not reach the field check.
zh: 本次上传未进入字段校验。

en: Settings for your linked Discord account.
This scoreboard is from a different match
zh: 此计分板来自另一场对局

en: Hide your name on the kills leaderboard.
zh: 在击杀排行榜上隐藏你的名字。

en: Hide your name on the level leaderboard.
zh: 在等级排行榜上隐藏你的名字。

en: Press Find game to queue again in Solos.
zh: 点击“寻找对局”再次进行单排排队。

en: Your screenshot shows a different result
zh: 你的截图显示了不同的结果

en: You can queue and invite friends again.
zh: 你可以再次排队并邀请好友。

en: Your friends from THE FINALS show here.
zh: 你在 THE FINALS 中的好友会显示在这里。

en: Claimed, with no answer recorded yet.
Finals.ID removed you from your party
Used when automatic detection is off.
zh: 在自动检测关闭时使用。

en: A newer screenshot replaced this one
zh: 较新的截图已替换此截图

en: This player cannot get an invite now
zh: 该玩家目前无法收到邀请

en: Bringing your hidden stats to life!
zh: 让你的隐藏数据活起来！

en: Do you agree to the Privacy Policy?

zh: 正在通过 Finals.ID 检查房间……

en: Finals.ID waits for the other team
zh: Finals.ID 正在等待另一支队伍

en: Needs both teams, or 3 of one team
zh: 需要双方队伍，或同一队伍的 3 张截图

en: Remember my status from THE FINALS
zh: 记住我在 THE FINALS 中的状态

en: We could not check this screenshot
zh: 我们无法校验这张截图

en: Your FIDR account was not created.
zh: 你的 FIDR 账号未创建。

en: Part of the scoreboard is missing
Set me Invisible while signing in
This account is no longer linked.
We did not accept your screenshot
Admin review when the clock ends
zh: 倒计时结束时由管理员审核

en: Invite a player after the match.
zh: 请在对局结束后邀请玩家。
邻域上限为 150 个节点

en: Show session stats on game close
zh: 游戏关闭时显示场次数据
双方队伍显示的结果不一致

en: An invite to this player is out

zh: 当前正在进行的场次数据
与 Finals.ID 共享对局延迟

en: This file type is not supported

zh: 我们正在校验你的截图

en: This match has no more uploads
zh: 本场对局已无法再上传

en: This player is in a FIDR match
zh: 该玩家正在参加 FIDR 对局

en: We cannot read the final score
zh: 我们无法读取最终比分
你的截图显示了不同的结果

en: No graph for this season yet.
Steam ID or Embark account id
zh: Steam ID 或 Embark 账号 ID

en: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
zh: 请使用 PNG、JPG 或 WebP 图片。

en: We cannot find this Embark ID
zh: 我们找不到此 Embark ID
管理员正在审核本场对局。
请在对局结束后邀请他们。

en: This player is in your party
zh: 该玩家已在你的小队中

en: Why is there so little data?
Are you sure you are ready?

zh: 正在等待 Steam 启动……

en: Did you like what you see?
zh: 你喜欢所看到的内容吗？

en: Your party is in the queue
This player is in a match

zh: 带自动加入的实时测试

en: Your party is in a match
Finals.ID detects the end of the test match, then reads the scoreboards. Take a screenshot of the final scoreboard: test results are void.
zh: Finals.ID 会检测测试对局的结束，然后读取计分板。请对最终计分板截图：测试结果作废。

en: General has been reimagined into a modular dashboard. You can now add, remove, drag, and resize cards around to suit your specific tastes.
zh: 「通用」已重构为模块化面板。现在你可以按自己的喜好添加、移除、拖动和调整卡片大小。

en: New Sessions tab: browse every play session the app has recorded, with kills, K/D, rounds, wins, RS change and the weapons you used.
zh: 新增「场次」标签页：浏览应用记录的所有场次，包含击杀、K/D、回合、胜场、RS 变化和你使用的武器。

en: Solo Showdown matches now have a preliminary design in the match history. I'll change and adjust it as necessary as I get more data.
zh: 单人决战对局现在在比赛记录中有了初步设计。等我拿到更多数据后会按需调整。

en: Signing in no longer pings friends as playing THE FINALS: the app sets you Invisible first, then restores your usual Steam status.
zh: 登录时不再向好友显示你正在玩 THE FINALS：应用会先将你设为隐身，再恢复你平时的 Steam 状态。

en: Fixed the rank score graph so it shows only the current season, instead of mixing in last season's scores from before the reset.
zh: 修复了段位分图表：现在只显示当前赛季，不再混入重置前的上赛季分数。

en: Session summaries now come straight from the server and update live. No more weird kill counts in the post-game summaries.
zh: 场次摘要现在直接来自服务器并实时更新。赛后摘要里不会再出现奇怪的击杀数了。

en: The queue was cancelled. The Finals.ID app of a player in your party stopped responding: it may be closed or offline.
zh: 队列已取消。你小队中一名玩家的 Finals.ID 应用停止响应：可能已关闭或离线。

en: Finals.ID detects the end of the match. Before you leave the end screen, take a screenshot of the final scoreboard.
zh: Finals.ID 会检测对局的结束。离开结算界面前，请对最终计分板截图。

en: Light mode fixes: the Matches screen keeps its readable colors, and the match cards and popups are a bit less dark.
zh: 浅色模式修复：比赛界面保持可读的配色，对局卡片和弹窗也不再那么暗。

en: This counts toward being flagged for disruptive behavior. Too many missed or declined matches are bad for the game.
zh: 这会累计到扰乱行为标记。错过或拒绝的对局太多会影响游戏体验。

en: Added Share tournament button under finished tournaments in Match History, to match the website. Share your pain!
zh: 在比赛记录中已结束的锦标赛下新增「分享锦标赛」按钮，与网站保持一致。分享你的痛苦吧！

en: This server does not start tests from the app yet. Start it on the Finals.ID admin console, then press Join test.
zh: 该服务器暂不支持从应用内启动测试。请在 Finals.ID 管理控制台启动，然后按「加入测试」。

en: This session has no milestones, live joins, lobby reads or host steps: Finals.ID sends them on its admin routes.

en: During a Ranked or Cashout match, the Ranked card on General shows your live ping. Your ping is also optionally recorded and sent to the server, to provide per-match ping history. This information will also be used to help the Status page on the website to better reflect real ping conditions worldwide. You can disable this in the Settings if you do not want this.
zh: 在排位或提现对局中，首页的「排位」卡片会显示你的实时延迟。你的延迟也可选择被记录并发送到服务器，以提供每场对局的延迟历史。这些信息还将用于帮助网站的状态页面更准确地反映全球真实延迟情况。如果你不希望如此，可以在设置中关闭。

en: Fixed a Steam login 'error' that blocked us from getting the account token properly. Please contact embark support, tickets, or the feedback channel and ask for an official API. We have still not received word from them on our own requests. And yet they have time for this. And also banning mention of the site on the main discord. It is ridiculous.
zh: 修复了一个 Steam 登录「错误」，此前它导致我们无法正常获取账户令牌。请联系 Embark 支持、工单或反馈频道，要求提供官方 API。我们自己的请求至今仍未收到他们的任何回复。可他们却有时间为这种事折腾，还要在主 Discord 上禁止提及本站。真是荒唐。

en: The map card is now split into two cards, Ranked and Cashout, each with its own timer and a new tooltip layout. When the exact Cashout map is not known yet it shows a best guess with the odds in the tooltip. This is done to reflect the changes Embark has done to separate Cashout and Ranked map rotations.
zh: 地图卡片现拆分为「排位」和「提现」两张卡片，各有独立计时器和全新的提示框布局。当提现地图尚未确定时会显示最佳推测，并在提示框中给出概率。这样做是为了反映 Embark 将提现与排位地图轮换分开的改动。

en: This match is historic and was pulled from Embark's servers directly. For matches that happen without an active token, we only get the basics from their systems. This includes map, event type, placement, kills, deaths, damage, and when it was played. That is it.
zh: 本场为历史对局，直接从 Embark 服务器拉取。对于没有有效令牌时发生的对局，我们只能从他们的系统获取基础信息，包括地图、事件类型、名次、击杀、死亡、伤害以及对局时间。仅此而已。

en: Access supports educational projects, non-commercial public websites, new community features, and esports tools for member match and performance data. Applications are reviewed individually. Betting, policy violations, and Finals.id replicas are not accepted.
zh: 访问权限支持教育项目、非商业公开网站、新的社区功能，以及用于获取成员比赛与表现数据的电竞工具。申请将逐份审核。博彩、违反政策的行为及 Finals.id 仿制品不予受理。

en: Before you submit: make sure the exact skin you want to name is the one equipped in-game, with Shuffle turned off. Give it a few minutes, then hit Refresh on the loadouts so we read your current skin, otherwise you may end up naming the wrong one.
zh: 提交前请确认：要命名的皮肤正是游戏内实际装备的那一个，且已关闭随机。稍等几分钟，然后在配装页点击刷新，让我们读取你当前的皮肤，否则可能会命名错误的皮肤。

en: We cannot detect the game as running, which means that you may not be able to join the lobby in time once you find a game, and receive a penalty. Please make sure your game is running and that you are in the main menu.
zh: 无法检测到游戏正在运行，这意味着找到对局后你可能无法及时进入房间，并受到惩罚。请确认游戏已启动并停留在主菜单。

en: Access is limited and revocable for policy violations or any other reason. Finals.id may modify, suspend, terminate, or interrupt API access at any time without notice, including for maintenance and error correction.
zh: 访问权限有限，且可因违反政策或任何其他原因被撤销。Finals.id 可随时修改、暂停、终止或中断 API 访问，恕不另行通知，包括因维护和错误修复。

en: Weapons with a skin we haven't catalogued yet now show a question mark over the icon. We need your help identifying them: click a flagged slot and submit the skin's name and rarity so everyone gets the right names.
zh: 带有尚未收录皮肤的武器，现在会在图标上显示问号。我们需要你协助识别：点击带标记的槽位并提交皮肤名称与稀有度，让大家都能看到正确的名称。

en: Session summaries now track your real match count, wins and losses, damage, and a Ranked vs Casual split, and the post-game popup has a Refresh button to pull in a match the server was still processing.
zh: 场次摘要现在会统计真实对局数、胜负、伤害，以及排位与休闲的拆分数据；对局结束弹窗新增刷新按钮，可拉取服务器仍在处理的对局。

en: The app refreshes the token roughly every 10-12 hours. Do you want it to boot Steam at that time if it's not open in order to finish its work? You can disable this functionality here if you don't.
zh: 应用大约每 10-12 小时刷新一次令牌。你是否希望在刷新时若 Steam 未启动则自动启动 Steam 以完成刷新？如果不需要，可在此处关闭该功能。

en: New Currently Playing bar: while a match is running, the home screen shows your live session so far. Kills, deaths, wins, matches, RS and the weapons you've used, updating as you play.
zh: 新增「正在游玩」栏：对局进行时，首页会显示你当前场次的实时数据。击杀、死亡、胜场、对局数、RS 以及你使用过的武器，都会随游戏实时更新。

en: If you want the full data always, please make sure to open the app at least once every time before you launch the game, which will refresh the token in our servers. Happy gaming!
zh: 如果希望始终获得完整数据，请在每次启动游戏前至少先打开一次应用，这会在我们的服务器上刷新令牌。祝游戏愉快！

en: Sessions are more reliable: a network blip when you close the game no longer loses the session, and a session that was interrupted is finished off the next time you open the app.
zh: 场次记录更可靠了：关闭游戏时的网络波动不会再丢失场次，被中断的场次会在下次打开应用时补完。

en: is one sitting the server recorded. Combat, Support and Objective are the sitting totals. Radar spokes are per match against exceptional ceilings. Local jsonl is not mixed in.
zh: 是服务器记录的一场场次。战斗、支援与目标为本次场次合计。雷达图辐条为每场对局相对于极限上限的数值。本地 jsonl 不计入。

en: Start Finals.id Companion App automatically when you sign in to your computer. It runs quietly in the tray and keeps your session alive, so your stats always stay up to date.
zh: 登录电脑时自动启动 Finals.id Companion App。它会在托盘中静默运行并保持会话有效，让你的数据始终最新。

en: Enhanced the skin submission process: naming an unidentified skin now sends along the weapon it's equipped on, so your submission lands on the right art and resolves faster.
zh: 优化了皮肤提交流程：为未识别皮肤命名时现在会一并提交其所属武器，使提交对应到正确的图像并更快处理。

en: Explain your audience, the data you need, and what your project adds. Public website applications must be non-commercial and must not duplicate existing Finals.id features.
zh: 请说明你的受众、所需数据以及你的项目带来的价值。公开网站申请必须为非商业用途，且不得重复 Finals.id 已有功能。

en: Minimize redundant requests. Reuse or cache results only where response Cache-Control permits. Never override no-store directives, privacy changes, or revoked access.
zh: 尽量减少重复请求。仅在响应 Cache-Control 允许时复用或缓存结果。绝不绕过 no-store 指令、隐私变更或已撤销的访问权限。

en: Steam starts Invisible and stays that way after the refresh, so friends don't see you come online while you're away. You stay Invisible until you change it in Steam.
zh: Steam 会以隐身状态启动，并在刷新后继续保持，这样你不在时好友不会看到你上线。除非你在 Steam 中更改，否则会一直保持隐身。

en: Help name skins the app hasn't identified yet: click a loadout slot, then submit a name and rarity for any unknown cosmetic. Thanks for helping build this out!
zh: 帮助为应用尚未识别的皮肤命名：点击配装槽位，然后为任何未知外观提交名称与稀有度。感谢你一起完善这些数据！

en: This slot is set to Shuffle, so its skin changes every refresh and can't be identified. Turn Shuffle off in-game, pick one skin, then reload and name it here.
zh: 该槽位已设为随机，皮肤每次刷新都会变化，无法识别。请在游戏内关闭随机，选定一个皮肤，然后重新加载并在此处为其命名。

en: Results will be available once everyone has submitted a screenshot of the final scoreboard displaying all 6 players, as it is shown once the match ends.
zh: 等所有人提交显示全部 6 名玩家的最终计分板截图后即可查看结果，因为该计分板会在对局结束时显示一次。

en: If the screenshots of the two teams still show different results when the clock ends, an admin reviews the match. No rating changes until then.
zh: 如果计时结束时两队截图结果仍不一致，将由管理员复核本场对局。复核完成前排位分不会变动。

en: THE FINALS and all related assets are property of Embark Studios. This app is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Embark Studios.
zh: THE FINALS 及所有相关资产归 Embark Studios 所有。本应用为非官方工具，与 Embark Studios 无隶属关系，也未获其认可。
